m0-context.title: Load baseline context and verify handoff complete
m0-context.imperative: Read handoff + problem statement. Verify: task defined, intent clear, allowed scope known (tests/integration/ + evidence/), exclusions known (no src/), test mode (test-after), stop conditions defined, return format specified.

postconditions.statement: handoff complete; scope, exclusions, stop conditions all understood

m1-write-integration-test.title: Write tests/integration/test_module_record_emit.py
m1-write-integration-test.imperative: Using test_utilization_determinism.py as pattern: skip guard, bounded training (1 module, 2 train years, max_rounds=1, 2 epochs, seed 0, threads 1). Train once, backtest twice (flag off / flag on) against same bundle. Assert: JSON byte-identical; sidecars only flag-on; load_module_record round-trips real record.

m2-run-integration-test.title: Run the integration test and capture output
m2-run-integration-test.imperative: py -m pytest tests/integration/test_module_record_emit.py -q. Must PASS (not skip). Capture output.

postconditions.statement: pytest passes with 0 failures, 0 errors, test RUNS not skips

m3-simplification-check.title: Run simplification_limits on the new test

m4-write-smoke-config.title: Write .agent-work/issue-371-module-record/evidence/g4_smoke_config.toml
m4-write-smoke-config.imperative: Write smoke TOML: mode=smoke, train_years=[2022,2023], eval_year=2024, emit_module_record=true, bounded budgets (2 epochs, seed 0), output_dir+report_dir inside evidence/. No src changes.

m5-run-smoke.title: Run the gold-cycle smoke in background and wait for completion
m5-run-smoke.imperative: Launch py -m src.evo_predictor.run gold-cycle --config evidence/g4_smoke_config.toml --max-rounds-per-year 1 redirected to evidence/g4_smoke_run.log. Wait for completion. Stop if >60 min or errors.

postconditions.statement: log exists and shows completion without error

m6-capture-evidence.title: Write evidence/g4-smoke-run.md with command, duration, record listing, load printout, no-echo spot-check
m6-capture-evidence.imperative: Gather: exact command, wall-clock duration, grouped *.record.* listing (mains/loso/calibration), one loaded-record printout, details.json spot-check for no emit_module_record key.

postconditions.statement: evidence/g4-smoke-run.md exists with all required content
